installAgentPrompt: Whakaritea a HAX (https://haxtheweb.org) ki tēnei rorohiko. Tāutahia te HAX CLI mā `npm install @haxtheweb/create --global`, kātahi ka tāuta i ōna pūkenga kaihoko mā `hax skills install --all`. Waihangatia he pae mā `hax site my-hax-site --y --no-i`, tīmatahia mā `cd my-hax-site && hax serve`, ka kī mai ai i te wāhitau ka tāngia e ia. Pānuitia te AGENTS.md o te pae me https://github.com/haxtheweb/praw i mua i tō panoni i tētahi mea.
